value.rationale: The universal finite face-orbit criterion replaces infinitely many rank-one norm equations by a finite combinatorial test. It classifies every cyclic and reflective isometry subgroup for an infinite natural family of polyhedral planes and identifies the exact minimal subgroup order, with a proof that reflections cannot reduce it.
